scope.description: The in-repository FileSnapshotStore with retention at least two, holding two snapshots whose last-entry terms and indexes are ordered in opposite directions, listed through List.
assumptions: Both snapshots are created through the public Create/Write/Close path and are retained, so List returns both.
The store is otherwise healthy: metadata readable and versions supported.
excluded: Other SnapshotStore implementations supplied by callers
The downstream effect in sendLatestSnapshot or startup restore, which remains a limit rather than part of this obligation
Snapshots whose terms and indexes are ordered in the same direction, where both comparator statements agree

parameters.implementation_comparator: snapMetaSlice.Less compares Term before Index under sort.Reverse

properties.reason: Independent applicability, correlated prerequisites and fully observed result comparison

adaptations: The snapshots use an empty Configuration and a real in-memory transport only to satisfy the Create signature; the ordering under test does not depend on them.
The store is a real FileSnapshotStore rooted in the test's temporary directory with retention 2, so both snapshots are retained.

plan_uncertainties: The check exercises the storage ordering contract directly and does not establish that a running node retains inversely ordered snapshots, nor any consequence in sendLatestSnapshot or startup restore.
Only the in-repository FileSnapshotStore is tested; other SnapshotStore implementations are caller-supplied.
grounding_unresolved: Whether a running node retains inversely ordered snapshots.
Whether the term-first comparator is deliberate ordering that only the interface wording contradicts.
Whether a running node produces inversely ordered retained snapshots through normal replication.
